issue_title: Percent-encode pipe character in URL paths
issue_body: The pipe character was not percent-encoded in URL path segments.
problem_statement: HTTPX leaves pipe characters unencoded in path segments.
expected_behavior: A pipe in a URL path is encoded as %7C.
reproduction_command: PYTHONPATH=tmp/httpx-before-src python -c import httpx; assert httpx.URL('http://example.com/a|b').raw_path == b'/a%7Cb'
environment: Windows AMD64; Python 3.11.15; fixed source commit
acceptance_test: hidden test asserts pipe is percent-encoded in URL path
